messages:
Maya: heads up — customer Ember reported fuzziness after we merged their LoRA into 4-bit checkpoint, quick smoke needed :mag_right:
Ravi: copying steps I ran locally, got decent throughput but a few hallucinations on slot-fill prompts
Anjali: can you paste failing examples? also which tokenizer mapping did you apply?
Ravi: example: prompt `Fill: <NAME> works at <ORG>.` model returned `Fill: <NAME> works at #ORG#.` tokenization looks shifted for angle-bracket tokens
Maya: hmm that looks like token ID collision after quant+merge, thanks. @ci-bot kick off evalpack ep-6721 (ember-onboard-fast)
ci-bot: started evalpack ep-6721 — runs: 120 tests, slices: handful (entities, dialogue, instruction-following). results posted to https://ci.internal/ep-6721 :rocket:
Jon: quick glance at CI logs shows mismatched vocab offset when applying adapter stitching: `Warning: tokenizer_vocab_offset != adapter_token_offset`
Anjali: Ok, probable cause is adapter was trained with a custom token remap for `<` and `>` to avoid special tokenization. Merge script doesn't preserve remap metadata by default
Ravi: repro command I used:
```
run_merge --base model-v2.1-int4 --lora ember-lora-v3 --preserve-token-remap false --out ember-merged-int4
python -m ember_eval --evalpack ep-6721 --model ember-merged-int4
```
Maya: that `--preserve-token-remap false` is the root cause — why was it false?
Ravi: I toggled it to false to force deterministic bytes for caching, my bad — forgot remap tag.
Anjali: short-term: re-run merge with `--preserve-token-remap true` and re-quantize, then rerun smoke. Also add a unit test to adapter-merge that verifies tokenizer->adapter token ids align
Maya: agreed. can someone run it and report perf delta? ops-bot, please queue on dedicated pool if available (customer Ember on dedicated trial)
ops-bot: queued job ember-merge-171724 for dedicated-gpu-pool-3, ETA ~6m
Ravi: re-run command with remap preserved:
```
run_merge --base model-v2.1-int4 --lora ember-lora-v3 --preserve-token-remap true --out ember-merged-int4-fix
quantize --in ember-merged-int4-fix --bits 4 --out ember-merged-int4-fix-qt
python -m ember_eval --evalpack ep-6721 --model ember-merged-int4-fix-qt
```
Jon: initial eval summary: entities slice PR up from -12% -> -1.8%, overall pass rate improved from 81% -> 95% on the smoke pack. latency +3% (expected due to remap metadata).
Maya: excellent. can we add a merge-time warning if adapter metadata contains token_remap and preserve-token-remap=false?
Anjali: yes I'll open a tiny PR to runtime/merge-tooling and add a test. tagging @Jon to validate perf regression guardrails
Maya: thanks team. I'll reply to Ember support with ETA and root-cause. keep the thread updated if anything else pops up :thumbsup:
